user.title: Add Zonentra
user.description: Like Versatile Thermostat: first create the central configuration (building, outdoor unit groups and shared settings) once, then add every zone separately. Zonentra sets the outdoor unit stand per group; a room is only regulated once its Room regulation switch is on.

central.title: Central configuration
central.description: Choose a name and the outdoor temperature sensor. Everything else starts at the defaults: set the limits on the central device and the other subjects (presence, room regulation, screens, weather forecast, outdoor unit groups) via Configure.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: One room with its temperature sensor, indoor units (existing climate entities) and outdoor unit group. Disable a central choice to enter local values in the next step. The room gets its own Zonentra thermostat; its indoor units are only switched once its Room regulation switch is on.

data_description.office_schedule_entity: Select a schedule helper. Ordinary rooms prepare automatically before opening, including while absent. A maximum 15-minute arrival grace follows opening; presence and motion then determine comfort. Calendar rooms continue to follow their bookings.
data_description.workday_entity: Separate from opening hours: on = workday, off = non-workday. Choose a sensor for today (offset 0). data_description.manual_override_enabled: Pauses automatic control after manually switching on a linked air conditioner. With room regulation enabled, this also applies to manual switch-off and setpoint changes by a Home Assistant user. This is separate from temporary targets on the Zonentra thermostat.
data_description.setpoint_interval_seconds: Used per air conditioner for both setpoint regulation and automatic fan speeds.

screens.title: Screens
screens.description: Rain protection uses the current rain-source state, defaulting to the central weather entity (including Pirate Weather). Rain/thunder/precipitation opens screens immediately; shading resumes after the dry hold. Opening bypasses normal delays and manual pauses. The block entity still blocks every move. Remote weather data may miss or report local rain late. Wind protection uses current wind and gust attributes of the central weather entity, with separate manufacturer limits in km/h. Without known manufacturer limits, only the current windy/windy-variant condition is used; this does not establish safe local wind. After an alarm, checked readings must remain at or below 80% of their limits during the calm hold. Both wind and rain must release before shading may lower again.

data.screen_rain_dry_minutes: Dry hold before shading may lower again (minutes; default 30)
data.screen_rain_max_age_minutes: Maximum weather report age (minutes; default 60; binary_sensor uses availability)
data.screen_wind_protection: Use wind protection (current wind condition; limits optional)
data.screen_wind_speed_limit: Maximum sustained wind (km/h; enter manufacturer limit, empty = not checked)
data.screen_wind_gust_limit: Maximum wind gust (km/h; enter manufacturer limit, empty = not checked)
data.screen_wind_calm_minutes: Calm hold before shading may lower again (minutes; default 30)
data.screen_wind_max_age_minutes: Maximum wind weather report age (minutes; default 60)

forecast.title: Weather forecast
forecast.description: The hourly forecast makes a day warm, neutral or cold: screens shade early on warm days, and heating or cooling starts later when the weather will do the work. Thresholds and margin are set on the central device.

data.weather_entity: Weather forecast (optional; warm/cold days for screens and fewer heat/cool changeovers)

group_details.title: Outdoor unit group
group_details.description: The feedback source must report heat, cool or off. Use reliable feedback, not a requested mode. Without feedback the actual mode stays unknown. This source supplies mode feedback; the group switch enables active control. Valid one-sided heating or cooling requests are followed without score gates; score thresholds apply only to opposing requests. Minimum run and switch times still apply.

equipment_details.title: Equipment
equipment_details.description: Register each indoor unit (an existing climate entity) as HVAC equipment in its zone; several units per zone and per outdoor unit group are supported. Optional links can be cleared. This legacy configuration observes equipment and calculates plans; active control uses central configuration and zone entries.
